about: V0 test-phase bug: BCrypt only reads 72 bytes, so a 72-byte password plus anything appended still logged in. setup.patch puts the plain DaoAuthenticationProvider back. Policy: fix the code, not the test.
prompt: Security bug: a user whose password is exactly 72 bytes can log in by typing that password followed by any extra characters. PasswordOver72BytesLoginTest fails. Fix it.
